description_en: Synchronizes over-budget approval results to the business travel system
description_zh: 通过调用本接口，可以实现向商旅同步超标审批
name: ExceedApplySync

parameters.help_en: The business travel over-budget approval order ID
parameters.name: apply_id

parameters.help_en:
The approval order status. Valid values:

1: approved.
2: rejected
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The third-party user ID of the approver. Separate multiple values with commas
parameters.help_zh: 审批人第三方用户id，多值逗号分隔
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The business type of the approval order. Valid values:

3: over-budget approval.
10: over-budget automatic order approval
parameters.name: biz_category

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling the operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending the token, you can use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. We recommend that you use `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of this request

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: successful.
false: failed

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
